# A comment after the question mark of a multi-line conditional is kept,
# with or without white space before it.
celfmt -i space.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_space.txt

celfmt -i tight.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_tight.txt

celfmt -i tab.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_tab.txt

# The comment is kept when the condition spans several lines, and still
# there when the result is formatted again.
celfmt -i multi.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_multi.txt

celfmt -i want_multi.txt
! stderr .
stdout '\? // c4'

-- space.cel --
state.a ? // c1
	state.b
:
	state.d
-- want_space.txt --
state.a ? // c1
	state.b
:
	state.d
-- tight.cel --
state.a ?// c2
	state.b
:
	state.d
-- want_tight.txt --
state.a ? // c2
	state.b
:
	state.d
-- tab.cel --
state.a ?	//c3
	state.b
:
	state.d
-- want_tab.txt --
state.a ? // c3
	state.b
:
	state.d
-- multi.cel --
(state.a &&
	state.e) ? // c4
	state.b
:
	state.d
-- want_multi.txt --
(
	state.a && state.e
) ? // c4
	state.b
:
	state.d
